entries.note: Hillier 2009 (PMID 19706750, epub 2009-08-25) abstract carries the quote verbatim; LNCaP/PC3 opener, untested.
Zechmann 2014 (PMID 24577951, epub 2014-02-28) abstract verbatim; 124I-MIP-1095 PET tumour uptake is a direct readout pairing with Hillier 2009.

Kratochwil 2016 (PMID 26985056) verbatim but the sentence shows selection, not the readout; 'Mean tumor-absorbed dose ranged from 6 to 22 Gy/GBq during cycle 1' supports same. No PSMA-negative patients dosed, so prediction_level should be class, not patient; model_src Benesova 2015 has no PSMA-negative arm (Umbricht 2017 does).
Wang 2011 (PMID 21750220) abstract; only the <= glyph differs. ADC-track opener, untested.

Petrylak 2020 (PMID 31742767, epub 2019-11-19) verbatim; same holds. NCT01695044 results (posted 2017-02-23) report PSA/CTC/radiologic response only, not the PSMA-expression association, so the comparison was first public at epub: year 2019.
Benesova 2015 (PMID 25883127) abstract verbatim; LNCaP-only biodistribution, no activity target or tolerated dose stated; untested with margin_stated false is right.

Kratochwil 2016 verbatim, but 'rapid clearance from the kidneys' is a PK property, not a NOAEL/MTD or tolerated-dose-at-effective margin, and the mouse stated no human-unit activity target; margin_stated true and comparison_stated true unsupported. Decision 16: no stated margin -> untested.
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 16: 'low kidney uptake' is a qualitative PK property, not a NOAEL/MTD or tolerated-dose margin, and the mouse stated no human-unit target (decision 4 floor); no stated margin or target is untested.

entries.note: FDA review NDA 215833 p.41-42 verbatim (kidneys 0.43 Gy/GBq, 19 Gy); the review says the regimen came from human dosimetry and literature models were 'not used for labeling'. Same objection as dose 2. If a margin is wanted, Fendler 2017 (120 MBq effective 'without subacute hematologic toxicity') is the only stated one, and mouse MBq does not scale (#50/#99).
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 16: the 23 Gy kidney convention and 7.4 GBq x 6 regimen come from human dosimetry, which the FDA review says literature models did not inform; no model-stated margin or human-unit target, so untested (decision 4 scaling).

entries.note: Wang 2011 verbatim; DiPippo 2015 (PMID 25327986) 1-6 mg/kg weekly x4, no tolerated dose; phase 1 (PMID 30663074) MTD 2.5 mg/kg q3w, NCT01414283 no results. untested is right, but the judgement invokes the 'never reached because of toxicity' row, whose efficacy column is untested (see efficacy 5).
Hillier 2009 abstract verbatim; opener. FDA review p.38 confirms RM1-hPSMA (Fendler 2017) up-to-85% growth inhibition and improved survival at 120 MBq.

Sartor 2021 (PMID 34161051, epub 2021-06-23) verbatim; VISION NCT03511664 results posted 2022-05-09; rPFS/OS alternate primaries met. patient_trials verified: PSMAfore NCT04689828 results 2025-10-09 and ARROW NCT03939689 results 2025-10-14 (COMPLETED, PSA50 primary 62.9% vs 31.3%, Clin Cancer Res 2026 PMID 41779000), TheraP no CT.gov results, Hofman 2018 ANZCTR. ARROW not contra under #53 (primary met; rPFS/OS unpowered secondaries): agree with the drafter.

Buteau 2022 (PMID 36261050) verbatim; PSA RR is TheraP's primary endpoint stratified by a prespecified SUVmean cutoff, so endpoint_role should be primary, not null. Umbricht 2017 model side is binary PSMA+/- (PC-3 PIP/flu), so direction_only is right. A same-after-same entry with strengthens is outside rule 7 unless the class->patient prediction_level change counts as a status change (rule question).
Wang 2011 verbatim; DiPippo 2015 abstract confirms complete regression in LuCaP 96CR, unimpeded LuCaP 58, 'considerable variability in effects despite PSMA expression'. Opener, untested.

Petrylak 2020 verbatim; NCT01695044 co-primaries are PSA, CTC and radiologic response (results posted 2017-02-23, so year 2017 stands). The draft's own dose entry says the model's regimen was never reached because of toxicity with no stated margin; decision 16 / decision 4 case 1 then make efficacy untested, not contra. Also CTC50 was 78% and the source calls it 'some activity'. Alternative: keep contra and re-word dose 4 as 'no human-unit target stated'.
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 4 case 1 / decision 16: the draft's dose 4 says the ADC was toxicity-capped below the model regimen with no stated margin, so never tested at an effective exposure; efficacy untested (run precedent; split co-primaries also bar contra).

entries.note: Hillier 2009 verbatim; opener. The cold-ligand rat/minipig toxicology the judgement sets aside is quotable in the FDA review (see missing) and should be a track.

Zechmann 2014 verbatim (salivary 3.8 mSv/MBq highest, 25% dry mouth). Salivary uptake is measurable in mice (Roy 2020 in vivo rodent biodistribution), so the mouse's low ranking is an askable miss under #13/#54; contra stands, with the species-expression rule question below.

Roy 2020 (PMID 32074455, epub 2020-02-19) verbatim; a stated species-tissue comparison, not a patient-outcome comparison, so comparison_stated true is generous but acceptable as the reconciliation (#79). VISION dry mouth 38.8% vs 0.5% and lacrimal 2.1 / salivary 0.63 Gy/GBq confirmed in the FDA review. strengthens on contra->contra supplies the excuse rather than removing it; harmless.
Wang 2011 verbatim; efficacy xenografts with no toxicology readout; ADC-modality opener, untested.

Petrylak 2020 verbatim (two sepsis deaths at 2.5 mg/kg); Younes 2010 (PMID 21047225) abstract names neutropenia and peripheral neuropathy for brentuximab vedotin, so other (same vc-MMAE platform) holds. imported_from should be MONDO:0004952 (Hodgkin lymphoma, the Younes 2010 population; OLS-verified), not null.

FDA review 5.1 under 'The FDA's Assessment' (bundle l.1133; PDF p.35) verbatim. Separate system from the xenograft track (healthy rat/minipig, cold ligand, ligand-mediated harm), so its own model_id is right under decisions 6/8. Year 2021 is the NDA-receipt proxy; the GLP package necessarily predates VISION's 2018 IND, but no source dates it, so no change.

Fragment verbatim, but the fetched 17 MB PDF (210 pp.) lacks pp. 36, 40 and 42-50 (footers run 35->37, 41->51), so the sentence end is unrecoverable from FDA. EMA EPAR EMA/871459/2022 settles the null: 'At single iv doses up to 4.0 mg/kg in the rat and 1.8 mg/kg in the minipig, no mortality and no major adverse effects were observed'; NOAEL rat 4.0 mg/kg (150x), minipig 1.8 mg/kg (~400x), 4-week rat 0.4 mg/kg (15x); 'Rats and minipigs were shown to exhibit little toxicity'. Caveats: one high-dose rat nephroblastoma (EMA: nephrotoxicity 'cannot be excluded', framed as a PSMA/radiation concern) and minipig injection-site inflammation; direction_only same holds under #58. comparison_stated true is generous: 5.1 (FDA) and 8.2.1 (Applicant's section) never cite each other. Suggest the EPAR sentence as the quote.

Abstract (PMID 30737300, epub 2019-02-08) and jnm.snmjournals.org full text verbatim; untested opener, ex_vivo track separate from the mice is right. Wording error in model/note: the SMG specimens came from neck-dissection patients (some with chronic sialadenitis/atrophy), not the PET-imaged prostate patients; the authors call it an 'indirect comparison'. 'Same patients' holds only for the PCA-tissue arm.

Verbatim (abstract and full text). contra under the letter of decision 10: a post-hoc ex-vivo system built after the salivary harm was known (retrodiction true) that could not reproduce the in-vivo gland uptake; 2019 and magnitude opposite supported. Fix 'same men's glands': the comparison is indirect (neck-dissection SMG tissue vs 60 recurrent-PCA PET scans). source_calls_it miss is a stretch: Rupp reads it as non-PSMA uptake, not a model failure. Whether an assay that cannot show non-PSMA in-vivo accumulation is contra or outside scope is the rule question below; it does not reach the headline either way.

missing: Cold-ligand rat and minipig toxicology (FDA review NDA 215833 nonclinical section: 'Single dose IV administration of 175Lu-PSMA-617 and unlabeled PSMA-617 caused no toxicologic [findings]'; clinical section: 'the main expected toxicities of 177Lu-PSMA-617 are related to radiation damage to normal tissues') is a stated null prediction (#58) that held in VISION; it should be its own safety track (same, 2022, tier 2, model_kind animal, comparison_stated true), not set aside as unquotable.

Rupp 2019 (doi 10.2967/jnumed.118.222307, PMID 30737300): human submandibular-gland tissue autoradiography with 177Lu-PSMA-617 plus IHC against the same patients' 68Ga-PSMA-11 PET; an ex vivo patient-tissue model built after the salivary harm was known that failed to reproduce the in vivo uptake ('minimal signal on ARG' vs SUVmax 23.5), i.e. a retrodiction scored contra on its own track (decision 10, model_kind ex_vivo).

Fendler 2017 syngeneic RM1-hPSMA model (immunocompetent C57Bl6, murine line transduced with human PSMA) is drawn on the LNCaP/PC-3 xenograft track; if it is a separate system it needs its own model_id, and its 'without subacute hematologic toxicity' at the effective 120 MBq is the class's only stated tolerability margin.

Searched for LuCaP PDX or patient-derived organoid comparisons with radioligand patients (fc.py search, two queries): none found beyond DCFPyL imaging of PDX/organoids with no patient comparison; nothing to add on that front.
rule_questions: Dating (rule 7): does a trial's registry results posting date an entry whose comparison (here a PSMA-expression subgroup association) does not appear in the registry record, or only entries the record itself supports?

Decision 16: is a qualitative pharmacokinetic statement in a biodistribution paper ('rapid clearance from the kidneys') a stated tolerability margin, or must it be a NOAEL/MTD or a tolerated dose at or above a stated effective one? And does a mouse activity margin (120 MBq effective without subacute haematotoxicity) count when MBq per mouse cannot be scaled to human GBq?

Decision 4/16 coupling: when the model states only mouse mg/kg with no human-unit exposure target and the clinic was toxicity-capped at a lower dose intensity (PSMA ADC 2.5 mg/kg q3w vs 1-6 mg/kg weekly), is efficacy untested (never dosed to the model's regimen) or scored on the trial with dose untested for want of a target?

Safety silence: when the model species expresses the target far less in the organ at risk (rodent salivary PSMA lowest, Roy 2020) and the human uptake is largely non-PSMA-mediated (Rupp 2019), is the harm 'measurable in the model species' (contra, as drafted) or outside what the species could show, like CRS in a mouse?

Track membership: does a syngeneic murine line transduced with human PSMA in immunocompetent mice (RM1-hPSMA) share a model_id with human LNCaP / PC-3 PIP xenografts in nude mice, or is it a second system?
Rule 7: does a patient-level same following a class-level same on the same track (engagement 3, efficacy 3) warrant its own entry with strengthens, or does it belong in patient_trials?
Efficacy with three registry co-primary measures that split (PSA50 14%, CTC50 78%, radiologic SD): which one is 'the primary endpoint' when the model predicted tumour regression?

ARROW: a phase 2 whose PSA50 primary was met while unpowered rPFS/OS were not improved and the sponsor took the drug no further stays same/patient_trials under #53 as drafted; confirm that a met primary in a combination trial with a negative outcome signal never scores contra.

(models check) Decision 10 vs decision 4 'conditions the model never tested': when a retrodiction's own source reads the discordance as a mechanism the assay cannot measure (frozen-section autoradiography cannot show non-PSMA-mediated in-vivo gland accumulation, Rupp 2019), is the failed reproduction contra (literal decision 10, as drafted) or untested/outside scope, like CRS in a mouse (rule question 4 above)?

(models check) #58 with a truncated regulator sentence: the FDA fragment's end sits on a page withheld from the published PDF; may the entry's quote be replaced by a second regulator's full statement (EMA EPAR EMA/871459/2022, 'little toxicity', NOAELs), or must it stay on the fragment at medium confidence?

(models check) comparison_stated within one regulator document: do a nonclinical null (FDA's Assessment, 5.1) and a clinical attribution to radiation (Applicant's Position, 8.2.1) in the same review count as a stated comparison when neither section cites the other?

(models check) Decision 16: the EPAR states ligand-mass NOAEL margins for the cold ligand (15x repeat-dose rat, 150x/400x single-dose rat/minipig vs 275 ug). Is a ligand-mass margin a 'stated margin' for the dose cell of a radioligand whose clinical ceiling is radiation absorbed dose (dose 3 adjudicated untested), or does it belong to the tox track only?
